title.en: Planning (Development of Land Authorisation for Medical Clinics) Notification 2014

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Planning (Development of Land Authorisation for Medical Clinics) Notification 2014 and shall come into operation on 23 December 2014.
3. Subject to paragraph 4 and any other written law, the making of any material change in the use of any premises as a shop to a use as a medical clinic is authorised under section 21(6) of the Act.
